name: madera-local
description: Réplica local de un diseñador 2D/3D de muebles modulares con módulos anidados y cutlist con precios

scripts.build: mkdir -p public/vendor/three/build public/vendor/three/examples/jsm/controls public/vendor/three/examples/jsm/helpers public/vendor/pdf-lib && cp -f node_modules/three/build/three.module.js node_modules/three/build/three.core.js public/vendor/three/build/ && cp -f node_modules/three/examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js public/vendor/three/examples/jsm/controls/ && cp -f node_modules/three/examples/jsm/helpers/ViewHelper.js public/vendor/three/examples/jsm/helpers/ && cp -f node_modules/pdf-lib/dist/pdf-lib.esm.min.js public/vendor/pdf-lib/ && node --check server/server.js && node --check public/js/layout.js && node --check public/js/viewer.js && node --check public/js/app.js && node --check public/js/model.js
scripts.lint: node --check server/server.js && node --check public/js/layout.js && node --check public/js/viewer.js && node --check public/js/app.js
